engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: AIRBAG VW71 vehicles such as the 1Y New Beetle Cabriolet the following may apply:
Short circuit in wiring to/from Airbag Kontrol Modülü (J234) and ground.
Faulty Fuel Pump Relay (J17) and/or faulty Central Conv. Module (J393)
Airbag Kontrol Modülü (J234) defective
Short circuit in wiring to/from Airbag Kontrol Modülü (J234) and ground.
Faulty Fuel Pump Relay (J17) and/or faulty Central Conv. Module (J393)
stepByStepSolution:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: AIRBAG VW71 vehicles such as the 1Y New Beetle Cabriolet
Use the factory level wiring diagrams to Kontrol edin: for a short circuit in wiring to/from Airbag Kontrol Modülü (J234) and ground on the A125 "Crash Data" circuit. Note, all components must be unplugged before connecting a DVOM!
Remove the Fuel Pump Relay (J17) and faulty Central Conv. Module (J393) to see if this DTC will clear.  If the fault clears, reinstall one of the components at a time to determine the cause.
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Airbag Kontrol Modülü (J234) only after the wiring and all components on the A125 spliced circuit are ruled out as possible causes.
